title: Word order in questions
en:
Normal question order: (Question word) + auxiliary + subject + verb.

Where do you work? What are you doing? Did she call you? How long have you lived here?

With be the verb goes before the subject: Where is the office?

Prepositions often go at the end: Who do you work with? What are you talking about?
ru: Порядок слов в вопросе: (вопросительное слово) + вспомогательный глагол (do/does/did, am/is/are, have/has, can, will) + подлежащее + глагол. С be: Where is…? Предлог часто в конце: Who do you work with?
